walk.note: two-footed bird hop walk, feet planted in stance (0.0 cm slip), stride = distance per hop; speed = ground speed in m/s at scale 1

run.note: two-footed bird hop run, feet planted in stance (0.0 cm slip), stride = distance per hop; speed = ground speed in m/s at scale 1

idle.note: in-place clip: play at timeScale 1. perched breathing + slight head turn

hover.note: in-place clip: play at timeScale 1. in-place hover; root is raised by air_offset_m

fly.note: in-place clip: play at timeScale 1. forward flapping flight; set flight speed in game; suggested flight speed 3.5 m/s

glide.note: in-place clip: play at timeScale 1. wings out, gentle sway; suggested 5 m/s

death.note: fall, settle on its side, holds last pose

land.note: one-shot: descends air_offset_m to the perched idle pose (root y animates)

takeoff.note: one-shot: crouch, push off, rises air_offset_m, ends on the first frame of hover
